relations.note: Scholars associate the armed, descending Macuiltonaleque with dangerous stellar beings.
Macuiltochtli belongs to their rabbit-pulque complex, though no kinship is established.
Macuiltochtli overlaps with Ometochtli through rabbit symbolism, pulque, and intoxication.
Scholarship finds a structural and iconographic relationship linking them with pulque gods.
